description: Earthquake Simulator Video Archive is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). This film database provides links to a number of videos related to dynamic tests conducted at University of Illinois, Urbana-Champaign in the 1980s. Detailed descriptions of test setups, specimen drawings, instrumentation layouts, digital measurement data files (in.csv format), and related documentation are also provided. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 4 top-level files (CSV). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2th4g. Keywords: databases , earthquake simulator , earthquake engineering , video, dynamic tests, structural engineering. Published 2017-07-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
